verdict.rationale: MotherDuck has dedicated pricing and billing documentation. It describes a free trial and a Lite plan with 10 GB of free storage and free monthly compute, by-the-second billing, and fixed Duckling instance sizes from Pulse through Giga. Together these give a platform engineer a structural basis for estimating cost. However, the evidence never shows the actual per-unit rates for compute, storage or each Duckling size, which are needed to turn a workload into a dollar figure. The usage views and billing dashboard only help after consumption has happened, not before committing. missing for 10: published per-unit compute and storage prices, per-Duckling-size rates, a pre-commit cost calculator or worked billing examples, independent confirmation that bills are predictable.
